text:
Ben (sales): Quick sync — ZenithBank POC timeline + integration deliverables. They want a 3-week trial starting next Monday. Need clear owners for: SAML SSO, VPC peering, staging creds, perf/runbook, and success reporting. Can owners ack and call out blockers?

Emma (solutions-eng): Ack. I can coordinate. Proposed owners: SSO = Olivia + Kevin S., VPC = Kevin S., staging creds = me, perf = Jules + Marta, success reporting = Sanjay. Anyone object?

Kevin S. (eng-infra): VPC peering needs Zenith CIDR, peering window, and contact. Earliest slot I have is Wed morning. Also need a ticket with VPN/route maps.

Marta (eng-ml): For perf we'll need the actual prompt corpus (or representative set) and expected concurrency patterns. Also flag: if they push long-context prompts we'll need a quantization profile change — that adds ~1 day.

Olivia (security): I can own SAML validation and compliance checklist. Need sample user attributes and data classification. Also: SOC2 DPA and data retention notes from Zenith before we enable SSO.

Jules (eng-sre): Will run smoke + load tests. Target: smoke within 24h of staging creds, load test goal = 50 req/s sustained for 30m to validate autoscale. Need staging ingress + token and an env with identical runtime (quant/kv settings).

Sanjay (product): Proposed success criteria so we can align: 1) Latency p95 < 300ms for standard prompts 2) Embedding accuracy baseline (we'll use the provided eval set) 3) No data exfil incidents + compliance signoff 4) Demo-ready UI & runbook. I can own the report template.

Ben (sales): Zenith contact is Alice (alice@zenithbank.com). I'll ask for the CIDR and their preferred SSO metadata URL. They'll want a demo on Week 2 Friday.

Emma (solutions-eng): Adding checklist items here so it's concrete:
- SSO: obtain metadata URL, exchange certs, test SAML login (owner: Olivia+Kevin)
- Networking: VPC peering request (owner: Kevin)
- Staging: creds + test account (owner: Emma)
- Perf: prompt set + runbook + results (owner: Jules+Marta)
- Compliance: DPA + SOC2 signoff (owner: Olivia)
- Report: weekly status + final runbook (owner: Sanjay)

Kevin S. (eng-infra): Network snippet for their team — ask them to fill and return:

```
peer_request: {
  project: "zenith-poc",
  vpc_cidr: "10.10.0.0/16",
  region: "us-west-2",
  contact: "alice@zenithbank.com"
}
```

Marta (eng-ml): Emma — please drop the prompt set link into the ticket. If they can't share real data, a synthetic set with similar length distribution is fine. Also pinging @kevin for whether we can spin a quantized variant in staging.

Olivia (security): I'll start the compliance checklist now. Quick Q: will any of Zenith's PII be persisted in logs or is everything tokenized? Need to know for DPA scope.

Emma (solutions-eng): Ben said they prefer mask/pseudonymize; expecting no raw PII in logs but they need audit logs for who queried what.

Jules (eng-sre): Quick ask — PR for infra changes? Ping me the repo/PR so I can review before we run load. (I saw a PR number in the demo notes earlier: solutions/zenith-integration PR #342)

Ben (sales): Yep, PR #342. Emma, can you please rebase and remove any debug hooks? Need code-review + owners to approve by Thursday EOD.

Emma (solutions-eng): On it. I'll rebase today and drop a short checklist in the PR description.

Sanjay (product): One more thing — let's capture a minimal A/B during Week 2: baseline model vs quantized variant, same prompts, compare latency and quality. If quantized variant loses >3% on the eval metric we roll back.

Marta (eng-ml): Noted. I'll set up the eval harness and add the threshold to the report.

Ben (sales): Calendar invites incoming. Please flag any hard blockers in this thread. Need final go/no-go by Friday EOD so we can confirm Zenith's demo slot. :thumbsup:

Kevin S. (eng-infra): Acked. I'll open the peering ticket and link it here when done.

Olivia (security): I'll start the DPA review and ask legal for expedited turnaround.

Jules (eng-sre): I'll schedule the smoke/load windows and share the runbook.

Emma (solutions-eng): Thanks team — I'll consolidate owners into the project ticket and post updates.

Ben (sales): Thanks all. Closing loop once we have CIDR + metadata.
